cross_component_finding: REGISTRY DRIFT (not introduced by this extraction, flagging for reconciliation): the same real-world GSI partitioning feature already exists under two different concept ids in the registry - n1ql:index-partitioning (minted from cloud/n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/index-partitioning.json) and indexes:index-partitioning (minted independently from cloud/indexes/index-replication.json's concept list). This page links directly to the n1ql/ statement page, so n1ql:index-partitioning was used here, but a reconciler should check whether these two ids should be merged.
cross_product_finding: This guide is a worked-example wrapper around WITH-clause properties (nodes, num_replica, PARTITION BY HASH, action:move) that are already fully modeled as concepts from the n1ql/ round 5 sweep (alterindex.json, index-partitioning.json) and the indexes/ sweep (index-replication.json) - no new placement/partitioning/replication semantics were found; the guide's only contribution is procedural worked examples for options the reference pages already declare.
